P8029.corridor_notes: Part of 广东省输气管网一期管道工程 (Guangdong Province Phase 1 gas pipeline project, ~448km total, same parent project as P8028) — this PID = the Dongguan branch (东莞支干线). Existence of the branch confirmed by antpedia.com; endpoint-level primary source not found/readable this session (see blockers).
P8029.researcher_notes: GEM's PipelineName cell for this row contains embedded trailing \r\n control characters ("Guangdong Pearl River Delta gas pipeline network\r\n") — confirmed when matching payload JSON; stripped for matching, flagging the data-entry defect per task instructions. 'Tonghu Town' (GEM StartLocation) could NOT be confidently identified/geocoded: no administrative town of that name exists in Dongguan. The phonetically closest OSM match, 潼湖镇 (Tonghu Town, lon 114.1915569 lat 23.0852030), is in Huicheng District, Huizhou — not Dongguan — which is inconsistent with the 'Dongguan Branch' segment name and the network's Guangzhou-Huizhou trunk line already covering the Huizhou side separately, so it was deliberately NOT used as a guess. This needs a human/researcher with access to the paywalled doc88.com acceptance report (or Chinese-source lookup tools not available this session) to resolve.
P8029.blockers: Same session-wide search-tool constraints as P8028 (WebSearch budget exhausted; major search engines blocked scripted access). Additionally 'Tonghu Town' itself is unresolved/ambiguous — left ungeocoded rather than guessed at the wrong city. Zhangmutou (樟木头镇, Dongguan) geocoded confidently from the GEM-recorded name but without an endpoint-specific corroborating ref.
